title: Minimax Precision for Partial Conditional Effects at a Modifier Profile under Uniform Design
banked_reason: The promised named sharp observational precision frontier is still an open question: the proved oracle theorem and split-histogram bracket do not supply an explicit matched rate, exact oracle-survival region, or corresponding attaining rule and honest intervals.
gap_reasons: The promised named sharp observational precision frontier is still an open question: the proved oracle theorem and split-histogram bracket do not supply an explicit matched rate, exact oracle-survival region, or corresponding attaining rule and honest intervals.

Its bracket proves oracle equivalence when upsilon >= gamma/(2gamma+k), but supplies neither a confounding lower bound nor necessity of that threshold, leaving all genuinely new observational rates and critical logarithms unresolved.
proof_attempt_summary: The informal derivation established causal identification, the supplied-propensity benchmark, unweighted cell and retained-weight identities, and a data-only split-histogram sufficient oracle-equivalence bracket on the original public-uniform class. The inaccessible testing citation was replaced by a short paper-owned derivation from the exact Causalean total-variation testing inequality, and D0.5 mathematics passed without findings or cited checks. A matched observational frontier, necessary oracle-survival threshold, full-support confounding converse and critical logarithms remain open; no F stages, run-owned Lean module or Lean certification were produced.
tldr: Averaging treatment effects over additional controls creates a different confounding geometry from full-covariate point estimation. The question is the sharp absolute-risk and honest-interval precision for the unweighted partial effect \(\theta(P)\) at a fixed modifier profile under an exactly public uniform design. Independent nuisance smoothness permits distinct normal widths in the lower experiment and requires mixed projection resolutions in a data-only correction. The oracle benchmark is established separately. The observational rate, critical logarithms, ordinary Lipschitz endpoint and exact oracle-survival region are the principal open content; no observational exponent is assumed.
gap: Fisher and Fisher exploit a partial contrast smoother than the arm means under restricted series growth. KBRW derive full-covariate localized minimax results using selected-support lower constructions. These results do not determine matched profile precision on the fixed public-uniform class with independently rough confounding, nor its critical logarithms.
fill: The kernel derives \(r_n^\star\) through total original-record unweighted corrections and compatible full-support likelihood experiments, and determines when \(R_n,H_n\) retain the separately verified supplied-propensity order. Every finite-sample coverage requirement is included in the target; a sufficient nuisance-product condition alone does not answer it.
